name: Agreeee
summary: Agreeee is a Japanese puzzle video game developed by the indie developer Vestman. It was released on Steam on December 5, 2025.

name: Ball x Pit
summary: Ball x Pit is a roguelike video game developed by Kenny Sun and published by Devolver Digital. It was released on macOS, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Windows and Xbox Series X/S in October 2025, with a Nintendo Switch 2 version released later that month.

name: Coffee Talk Tokyo
summary: Coffee Talk Tokyo is a 2026 visual novel developed by Toge Productions and Chorus Worldwide. The game was published by Chorus Worldwide on 21 May 2026 for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Windows and Xbox Series X/S. It is a spin-off to Coffee Talk and Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly.

name: Duet Night Abyss
summary: Duet Night Abyss (Chinese: 二重螺旋; pinyin: Èrchóng Luóxuán; lit. 'Double Helix') is a 2025 free-to-play action role-playing game developed by Pan Studio and published by Hero Games.

name: Fate/EXTRA Record
summary: Fate/Extra Record (stylized as Fate/EXTRA Record) is an upcoming role-playing dungeon crawling video game developed by Type-Moon Studio BB and Meteorise and published by Aniplex. The game is a remake of the 2010 video game Fate/Extra, and was officially announced in July 2020.

name: Ill
summary: Ill is an upcoming survival horror video game developed by Team Clout and published by Mundfish Powerhouse. It is scheduled for release in 2027 for PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X and Series S. The game was revealed at Summer Game Fest in 2025.

name: LEGO Voyagers
summary: Lego Voyagers is a puzzle-platform video game developed by Light Brick Studio and published by Annapurna Interactive. It is a cooperative multiplayer video game in which two players, each assuming control of a Lego brick, must work together to progress.

name: Lost Soul Aside
summary: Lost Soul Aside‍ is a 2025 action-adventure role-playing game developed by Ultizero Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. The player assumes the role of Kaser, who embarks on a quest to save his sister Louisa and the rest of humanity from the Voidrax.

summary: Marvel MaXimum Collection is a 2026 video game compilation published by Limited Run Games. It includes six games based on Marvel Comics characters, originally released between 1990–1995.

name: Militsioner
summary: Militsioner is an upcoming 2027 immersive sim video game for Microsoft Windows, Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S developed by Russian developer TallBoys and published by Critical Reflex.

name: Of Ash and Steel
summary: Of Ash and Steel is an action role-playing game developed by Fire & Frost and published by tinyBuild for Windows. It was released on November 24, 2025.

name: Planet Zoo 2
summary: Planet Zoo 2 is a construction and management simulation video game developed and published by Frontier Developments. It is the sequel to Planet Zoo.

name: Planet of Lana II
summary: Planet of Lana II is a puzzle-platform video game developed by Wishfully and published by Thunderful Publishing.

name: Road to Vostok
summary: Road to Vostok is a first-person indie survival game developed by Finnish developer Antti Leinonen. The game is set in a post-apocalyptic scenario, centered on the border between Finland and Russia.

name: Scott Pilgrim EX
summary: Scott Pilgrim EX is a side-scrolling beat 'em up video game developed and published by Tribute Games, under license from Universal Pictures. name: Screamer
summary: Screamer is a 2026 racing video game developed and published by Milestone for PlayStation 5, Windows and Xbox Series X/S released in March 26, 2026. It is a reboot of the 1995 racing video game of the same name.

name: Star Trek Voyager: Across the Unknown
summary: Star Trek: Voyager – Across the Unknown is a rogue-lite survival strategy video game developed by Gamexcite and published by Daedalic Entertainment. It is based on the TV series Star Trek: Voyager.

name: The Drifter
summary: The Drifter is a pulp point-and-click adventure game developed and published by Australian developer Powerhoof for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It was released on July 17, 2025 for PC, with Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 following on June 22, 2026.

name: The Rogue Prince of Persia
summary: The Rogue Prince of Persia is a 2025 roguelite platform game developed by Evil Empire and published by Ubisoft. Part of the Prince of Persia series, the game follows an unnamed Prince carrying a magic bola as he rushes to save his homeland from an army of Huns.

name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4
summary: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 is a 2025 skateboarding video game developed by Iron Galaxy and published by Activision. Similar to Vicarious Visions' Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2, it is a remake of Pro Skater 3 (2001) and Pro Skater 4 (2002), which were originally developed by Neversoft.

name: Touhou Kinjoukyou ~ Fossilized Wonders
summary: Touhou Kinjoukyou ~ Fossilized Wonders (東方錦上京 ~ Fossilized Wonders.; lit. "Capital Atop Magnificence") is a bullet hell video game developed by Team Shanghai Alice.
